It, like everything else in this world, had been constructed of dark gray stone. There were two doors along the walls on each side of him and above each were the strange lamps that had been on the machines he had destroyed on the roads. At the far end of the hall, stood a pair of massive stone doors. Ky had been in enough castles and keeps to know that those doors probably led to some type of throne room or great hall. He started forward, keeping flames readied on each fist. He met no challenge as he crossed the first half of the hall. At that point, the doors in front of him slowly swung open. A series of small explosive sounds erupted from within and Ky was thrown backward as he felt his body being perforated with projectiles. Cursing he cast a projectile shield and then sent flames into the next room. He waited for the green flame to heal him, then started forward again. More small explosions erupted from beyond the doors. His shield deflected the projectiles and they whistled past Ky on either side, singing as they ricocheted off the stone walls behind him. Another sheet of flames silenced the explosions with a chorus of painful screams. "Xarok!" The voice was feminine, or Ky believed it was. He also detected the power behind the voice. The word caused him to pause his progress through the hall a moment. Ky shook off the effect and continued forward until he stood on the threshold of the doorway. He spread his shield around his body as he faced a semicircle of huge reptilian creatures. This room was lit by torches which flickered causing dancing shadows distorting the pale-blue scaled reptiles. Behind them, Ky could just make out a raised area in the center of the room that was occupied by a twenty foot high arachnid type female with pale-yellow skin. Her eyes, like his own were solid black orbs that gave no indication of reflection. "Arienna," Ky muttered, and stepped into the room. One of the creatures, thinking it had a clear shot at Ky's side, fired its weapon. The projectiles ricocheted off Ky's shield and flew into the creatures on the other side of the circle. Ky incinerated the offending reptile. "Xarok, kza rzamok!" Arienna shouted as she stepped down from her raised platform. "Xro kzam vrazk."

The reptiles surrounding Ky slowly lay their weapons on the floor and backed away from him. Ky relieved some of his frustration by melting the discarded weapons, then waited as his sister approached him. Ky knew that physical contact needed to be made so that they could understand each other and the prospect of this thing that was his sister touching him made him feel slightly nauseous. He stood his ground regardless. Ky knew that she was at least his equal in power and preferred not to have to fight her. She stopped a few feet in front of him, her nearest foreleg within his reach. Ky concentrated on his own language and shut his mind to everything else, then slowly extended his hand to touch her. The mental battle raged for several moments, neither wishing to accept the language of the other. Finally, Arienna took Ky's language and backed away, not hiding her disgust as she brushed her leg where he had touched her. "So, brother, why have you come here?" she asked as she backed to her raised perch. Ky removed the cup from his pouch and stepped forward. "The Lady sent me to ask you about this cup." Arienna hissed, then said in a quiet menacing voice, "You come here, wage war on my army, destroy the door to my fortress and expect me to answer your silly question about a cup?" Ky grinned and answered, "Yes." Arienna glared down at her little brother for a moment, then laughed. Her laugh resembled insane shrieking and Ky noticed that the guards cowered against the walls at the sound of it. He waited, keeping his grin, until the laughter ceased. "What do I get for answering your question?" Arienna asked quietly. Ky thought for a moment. While he was thinking his peripheral vision picked up movement from one of the guards. Not caring to wait to see what its purpose was, Ky incinerated it. Arienna mistook Ky's action as a threat to gain what he wanted. "If you intend to kill my guards," she said, waving one foreleg, "at least kill them in a way that I can feast on their remains." A series of loud popping sounds erupted around the room as the guards exploded, sending entrails and thick red blood showering through most of the room. Ky shrugged, then pulled a large emerald from his pouch. He tossed it onto the front of the raised platform and waited. Arienna studied the gem a moment then asked, "What about this cup do you wish to know?" Ky stepped forward and placed the cup next to the emerald and explained, "There are traces of dark magic within the cup. I need

to know what the purpose of that magic is." As Arienna examined the cup, Ky felt a sharp pain in his left ear. He staggered back a step, his hand absently covering the ear. When he pulled his hand away, a small trace of blood was smeared on his palm. Ky glanced at Arienna who did not seem to notice anything wrong. She still examined the cup, giving it her full attention. Nothing more happened for a while after that. "This will take some time," Arienna murmured. "This magic is foreign to me." Ky nodded and continued to wait. The next pain he felt came from his left ankle. Again, he found a small trickle of blood. His fists flared with flame, distracting Arienna in time to see Ky collapse. She scowled and moved from her platform to stand over Ky's body. "Doubtless, I will be blamed for this," she hissed. To be concluded in: Vengeance of the Ghost.
